verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe Track/Pipelines API for creating/updating profiles with custom properties (docs-3, docs-7), suppression and deletion via named events (docs-5), object/relationship support (docs-6), and API key-based data-in integration (docs-28), plus an OpenAPI spec confirming production API surface (probe-2). No explicit rate-limit/scale benchmarks or independent large-scale usage reports are provided. missing for 10: independent evidence of production-scale throughput/rate limits, third-party case studies confirming bulk contact operations at scale.
